existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Per-page copy fee ceiling - municipal and other agencies
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For all public agencies other than state offices/agencies, the fee for a copy of a public record shall not exceed fifty cents per page.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester receives a copy from a non-state public agency
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: (B) By all other public agencies, as defined in section 1-200, shall not exceed fifty cents per page.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Municipal/local rate. Ceiling: the city may set any per-page fee at or below $0.50. 'Page' means one side of a piece of printed matter (108 CA 471).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Per-page copy fee ceiling - state offices/agencies
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For state executive/administrative/legislative offices and state agencies (and judicial offices in their administrative functions), the copy fee shall not exceed twenty-five cents per page.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester receives a copy from a state office/agency
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: (A) By an executive, administrative or legislative office of the state, a state agency or a department, institution, bureau, board, commission, authority or official of the state, including a committee of, or created by, such an office ..., and also including any judicial office, official or body or committee thereof but only in respect to its or their administrative functions, shall not exceed twenty-five cents per page
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Same concept as CT-0015 with a different ceiling for state agencies; do not merge the values - the constraint differs by agency class.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: Where a copy requires a transcription, or a person requests a transcription of a public record, the transcription fee shall not exceed the agency's cost.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Copy requires, or requester applies for, a transcription
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If any copy provided in accordance with said Freedom of Information Act requires a transcription, or if any person applies for a transcription of a public record, the fee for such transcription shall not exceed the cost thereof to the public agency.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Ceiling = actual cost to the agency; no fixed number stated.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Fee for computer-stored records limited to cost with enumerated components
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The fee for a copy of computer-stored public records shall not exceed the agency's cost, and (for non-preexisting printouts) may include only enumerated components: employee hourly salary for producing/formatting/programming (not search/retrieval except sub-(4)), outside copying-service cost, actual storage-media cost, and certain computer-time charges.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request for a copy of computer-stored public records
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The fee for any copy provided in accordance with subsection (a) of section 1-211 shall not exceed the cost thereof to the public agency. In determining such costs for a copy, other than for a printout which exists at the time that the agency responds to the request for such copy, an agency may include only: (1) An amount equal to the hourly salary attributed to all agency employees engaged in providing the requested computer-stored public record ... but not including search or retrieval costs except as provided in subdivision (4) of this subsection; (2) An amount equal to the cost to the agency of engaging an outside professional electronic copying service ...; (3) The actual cost of the storage devices or media provided ...; and (4) The computer time charges incurred by the agency ... where another agency or contractor provides the agency with computer storage and retrieval services.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Ceiling = cost, with a closed list of includable components. Notably excludes search/retrieval labor except sub-(4). DAS issues guidelines for consistency. Kept in one row (closed enumerated list, not a bundle of independent duties).

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For certifying a copy of records/files (or certifying a fact appearing therein), the fee is one dollar for the first page and fifty cents for each additional page.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Requester asks the custodian to certify a copy or fact
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Except as otherwise provided by law, the fee for any person who has the custody of any public records or files for certifying any copy of such records or files, or certifying to any fact appearing therefrom, shall be for the first page of such certificate, or copy and certificate, one dollar; and for each additional page, fifty cents.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Fixed statewide amount ('except as otherwise provided by law'). Separate from and additive to the per-page copy fee.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Prepayment permitted when fee estimated at $10 or more
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public agency may require prepayment of any fee if the fee is estimated to be ten dollars or more.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: A public agency may require the prepayment of any fee required or permitted under the Freedom of Information Act if such fee is estimated to be ten dollars or more.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Discretionary. $10 is the floor at/above which prepayment may be demanded; the city sets whether/how it invokes it.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A public agency shall waive any copy fee when any enumerated ground applies: requester is indigent; records are exempt under 1-210(b); compliance benefits the general welfare in the agency's judgment; requester is an elected official of the political subdivision certifying the record pertains to official duties; or requester is Public Defender Services personnel/appointed counsel certifying the record pertains to their duties.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Any one of five enumerated waiver conditions is met
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The public agency shall waive any fee provided for in this section when: (1) The person requesting the records is an indigent individual; (2) The records located are determined by the public agency to be exempt from disclosure under subsection (b) of section 1-210; (3) In its judgment, compliance with the applicant's request benefits the general welfare; (4) The person requesting the record is an elected official of a political subdivision of the state and the official (A) obtains the record from an agency of the political subdivision in which the official serves, and (B) certifies that the record pertains to the official's duties; or (5) The person requesting the records is a member of the Division of Public Defender Services or an attorney appointed by the court as a Division of Public Defender Services assigned counsel under section 51-296 and such member or attorney certifies that the record pertains to the member's or attorney's duties.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Kept as one row (single 'shall waive' duty with disjunctive grounds). Mandatory ('shall'); ground (3) 'general welfare' rests on agency judgment.
